regions.merged_text: When all was over in the P.M. Aloysius Mccarthy to serve for 1st time arrived for duty and rang door-bell at 3.45 A.M. His brother John was his guardian. A. Dempsey, Wm Hays, and T. Fagan served almost the whole time. Packages were received after Vesp. and cribs.
